LanguageData.RKU_SharedBurdens.label: Shared Burdens
LanguageData.RKU_SharedBurdens.description: These underground ratkin are remnants of the revolutionary army that was defeated by the kingdom ten years ago. They once controlled half of the kingdom's territory, including the capital. However, the revolutionary army's organization collapsed due to the ravages of the bioplague and the corruption of the leadership. Most of the troops broke away from the organization and became warlords. Ten years have passed, and warlords and nobles of all sizes still ravage these chaotic regions. Only one unit from the revolutionary army's eastern front still maintains its original structure. They have occupied a kingdom vehicle factory, producing drilling vehicles to conduct underground guerrilla warfare. This unit aims to save civilians and end the civil war, but they are short on numbers, poorly equipped, and weak in strength.
